scenario_temp_id.description: Unique temporary ID for this scenario instance. Must be unique across all scenarios in the document. Format: S01, S02, etc.

scenario_label.description: Descriptive label for this specific scenario instance. Must uniquely identify this exact combination of parameters. Example: 'Baseline 2050 SSP2-4.5 Bedroom' rather than just 'Baseline'.

scenario_family.description: The high-level group this scenario belongs to. For intervention studies: 'baseline' or 'intervention'. For simulation studies: use the study's own grouping, e.g., 'baseline', 'ideal', 'power_failure', 'retrofit_package_A', etc.

building_case_id.description: Temporary ID linking to a building_case record from building_case_extraction. Null if not yet extracted or single-building study.

climate_zone.description: Climate zone classification (e.g., Köppen-Geiger, ASHRAE). May be extracted from the document or looked up externally if the location is known.

climate_zone_source.description: 'document' if the climate zone was explicitly stated in the article, 'external_lookup' if it was determined from the location using external knowledge/internet search, null if climate_zone is null.

year.description: The reference year or time period for this scenario. For current conditions use the actual year (e.g., '2020'). For future projections use the target year (e.g., '2050', '2080'). Null if not applicable.

ssp.description: Shared Socioeconomic Pathway or climate scenario identifier. Examples: 'SSP2-4.5', 'SSP5-8.5', 'RCP4.5', 'A2'. MUST be null if the document does not explicitly report a pathway. NEVER use 'current'.

climate_period_type.description: Type of climate period. Use 'current' for present-day climate (replaces former ssp='current'). Use 'future_projection' when an SSP/RCP is used. Use 'heatwave' for heatwave-specific analysis.

weather_year_or_period.description: Specific year or range: '2020', '2050', '2001-2020', etc. Null if not reported.

operational_mode.description: Operational status of the building systems in this scenario. Examples: 'normal_operation', 'power_outage', 'hvac_off', 'natural_ventilation_only', 'maximum_cooling', 'free_running'. Null if not applicable or not a simulation study.

baseline_description.description: Description of the reference/base case. For factorial simulation studies where there is no explicit baseline, describe the scenario conditions.

baseline_scenario_temp_id.description: The scenario_temp_id of the baseline/reference scenario this intervention is compared against. Null if this IS a baseline or comparison is unclear.

is_reference_baseline.description: True if this scenario serves as the reference baseline for other scenarios.

baseline_compatibility_status.description: Assessment of whether baseline comparison is methodologically valid.

intervention_description.description: Description of the intervention or strategy applied. Null if this scenario IS the baseline or if the study does not use a baseline/intervention comparison.

intervention_type.description: Type of intervention from expanded taxonomy. NEVER use 'passive_design'. Use specific types: solar_shading, natural_ventilation, evaporative_cooling, etc. Use 'not_applicable' for non-intervention scenarios.

intervention_package_simple.description: Human-readable summary of the intervention package. E.g., 'shading + misting', 'ventilation + thermal mass'. Null for non-packages.

passive_component_count.description: Number of passive components in the intervention. Allows comparing simple vs package strategies.

active_system_type.description: Type of active system if has_active_system is true.

reported_outcomes.description: ONLY outcomes explicitly reported with a recoverable form: value, table, figure, temporal profile, or quantitative text. Do NOT include inferred outcomes.
